operations.title: Operations ledger
operations.description: Channel reliability, immutable recorded upstream cost and accounting coverage in one operating view.

analytics.empty: No successful metered usage was attributed in this period.

models.title: Model analytics
models.description: Usage and economics are grouped by the public model requested by customers, while every actual upstream supply remains channel-specific.
models.realBuckets: Real usage time buckets grouped by the customer-facing public model.
models.scrollHint: Positioned at the most recent bucket with usage; scroll left or right to view the full range.
models.scrollPending: Positioning the latest buckets; scroll right for the latest data.
models.noTrend: Per-model time buckets are not recorded; this panel uses truthful distribution and ranking views.
models.detailDescription: Accounting totals belong to the public model; actual model and channel rows remain separate routing supplies.

flow.title: Request flow
flow.description: Inspect successful metered traffic from customer identity through the public model to the actual upstream supply.
flow.minimumStages: At least two stages remain visible.
flow.coverage: {{returned}} metered requests returned · {{usage}} usage rows · {{settled}} settled rows
flow.entitlementTitle: Why model groups are not a stage:
flow.entitlementNote: groups authorize access and may overlap. Runtime usage does not yet record one winning grant, so assigning a group here would fabricate attribution.

users.title: User consumption
users.description: Successful metered usage only—not login activity and not subscription or Credit balances.
users.channelContributionDescription: A truthful second view of each user's selected metric split across actual upstream channels; no time series is inferred.
users.detailDescription: Project, API key, public-model and channel reach with recorded cost, settled revenue and latest activity.

error.title: Could not load the operations ledger
error.description: The reporting service returned no data.

performance.retryDefinition: Second and later upstream attempts for one customer request

routeHealth.title: Route target health matrix
routeHealth.description: Tracked separately by upstream channel, actual model and selected credential. Only a one-way fingerprint is shown; provider keys are never stored or returned.
routeHealth.empty: No attributable upstream attempts in this period.

trend.title: Traffic, cost and settled revenue
trend.description: Empty time-series points are drawn from zero and rise with data; summaries still distinguish a real zero from unavailable accounting. Revenue includes only settled usage.
trend.emptyDescription: Choose traffic, finance, or reliability signals from the metrics menu.

reasons.USAGE_GROSS_PROFIT_SCOPE: Usage gross-profit only. Cash receipts, subscription sales, refunds, taxes and upstream invoice reconciliation are not recorded.
reasons.NO_METERED_USAGE: No metered usage occurred in this period; historical coverage has no sample.
reasons.NO_RECORDED_COST: No usage row has a recorded historical purchase cost; missing prices are not treated as free.
reasons.PARTIAL_RECORDED_COST: Only usage rows with an immutable recorded purchase cost are included.
reasons.COMPLETE_RECORDED_COST: All metered usage in this period has an immutable recorded cost.
reasons.NO_SETTLED_USAGE_REVENUE: No usage was successfully settled in this period; unpriced, unfunded and non-user requests are excluded from revenue.
reasons.PARTIAL_SETTLED_USAGE_REVENUE: Only usage successfully settled from subscription allowance or credit is included.
reasons.PROFIT_REQUIRES_REVENUE_AND_COST: Usage gross profit requires both settled usage revenue and recorded historical purchase cost.
reasons.PARTIAL_GROSS_PROFIT: Some usage lacks settlement revenue or purchase cost; gross profit covers only fully recorded rows.

HISTORICAL_COST_INCOMPLETE.title: Historical cost coverage is incomplete
HISTORICAL_COST_INCOMPLETE.detail: {{affected}} of {{total}} metered usage rows are missing immutable cost.

PURCHASE_PRICE_NOT_CONFIGURED.title: Enabled channel has no purchase price
PURCHASE_PRICE_NOT_CONFIGURED.detail: Future usage may be recorded without cost until a channel model purchase price is configured.

HIGH_ERROR_RATE.title: Elevated upstream error rate
HIGH_ERROR_RATE.detail: {{affected}} failed or canceled attempts out of {{total}} in this period.

NO_TRAFFIC.title: Enabled channel has no traffic
NO_TRAFFIC.detail: No upstream attempts were recorded in the last {{days}} day(s).

STALE_HEALTH_PROBE.title: Health probe is stale
STALE_HEALTH_PROBE.detail: No channel health probe has been recorded in the last 24 hours.

LOW_PROVIDER_QUOTA.title: Low upstream balance
LOW_PROVIDER_QUOTA.detail: Recorded remaining quota is at or below the configured warning threshold.

STALE_QUOTA_SNAPSHOT.title: Upstream quota snapshot is stale
STALE_QUOTA_SNAPSHOT.detail: The recorded provider balance has not been verified in the last 24 hours.

PENDING_CHARGE_ROWS.title: Charge rows are not settled
PENDING_CHARGE_ROWS.detail: {{affected}} charge event(s) remain pending or unsettled.

UPSTREAM_PRICE_STALE.title: Observed upstream pricing is stale
UPSTREAM_PRICE_STALE.detail: No upstream pricing observation succeeded in the last 6 hours.

UPSTREAM_PRICE_CHANGED.title: Upstream pricing changed
UPSTREAM_PRICE_CHANGED.detail: The latest observation contains {{affected}} added, removed, or changed prices.

table.title: All-channel operating ledger
table.description: Every configured upstream channel is shown, including disabled and zero-traffic channels.
